outcome: Mode of birth (caesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
cohort: Fifty-six women with physical disabilities who had given birth in the previous three years in two northern provinces of Vietnam (Hanoi and Thaibinh).
finding: Many women with physical disabilities are not given the opportunity to exercise informed choices around childbirth options due to external influences.
mod_finding: Many women with physical disabilities underwent caesarean sections, often mandated by healthcare providers or supported by family/peers, despite some expressing a preference for vaginal birth.
followup_time: Up to 3 years after birth (for the event being studied), with follow-up interviews conducted several months after the initial interview.
